newsletter.note: Free RSS-to-email: create a publisher account at https://follow.it, add the feed https://mohdshayan.com/feed.xml, open the subscription-form embed, and paste the form's action URL here (it looks like https://api.follow.it/subscription-form/XXXX/8). Run npm run build. Buttondown users: set provider to buttondown and username instead.

tools.note: Each free tool is published at https://<slug>.mohdshayan.com/ by the Deploy subdomains workflow (see SUBDOMAINS.md). Leave this false until those addresses resolve; while false, links, canonicals and the sitemap use https://mohdshayan.com/tools/<slug>/. Set it to true and run npm run build once they are live.
